member.name: P:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.IDicomImageModel.DefaultWindowLevel
member.summary: Gets the default parsed from DICOM tags (0028,1050) and (0028,1051) when the series was loaded. Returns when no series is loaded, the DICOM tags are absent, or the stored WW value is not strictly greater than zero.

member.name: P:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.IDicomImageModel.HasValidDefaultWindowLevel
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the model holds a valid DICOM default Window Level (i.e. is non- and WW > 0).

member.name: P:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.IDicomImageModel.IsSeriesLoaded
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether a CT series is currently loaded in the viewport, independent of whether that series carries valid DICOM windowing tags. A series loaded without windowing tags, or with an invalid WW, is still loaded — the reset action must remain available so that fallback defaults can be applied (FR-01, FR-04, FR-07). Returns only when no series has been loaded.

member.name: P:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.IDicomImageModel.HasDicomWindowingTags
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the series was loaded with windowing tag data (DICOM tags 0028,1050 / 0028,1051), regardless of whether the stored values are valid. Returns when no series is loaded or the tags were absent. Used by callers to distinguish "tags absent" from "tags present but invalid WW".

member.remarks: All code paths that produce a must go through so the WW > 0 invariant is enforced structurally and cannot be bypassed.
